steps.slow: Downloads Microsoft's DirectX June 2010 redistributable (about 100 MB) and installs its XAudio 2.0 to 2.7, XACT and X3DAudio libraries into the environment, a few minutes.

steps.text: Microsoft's 32-bit XAudio 2.7 and XACT are installed and preferred over Wine's own in this environment. Some older 32-bit games play their sound through middleware that Wine's XAudio does not satisfy (CRI's ADX in Binary Domain, highball-db#345), and come out silent or broken without them. Every 32-bit game in the environment that uses XAudio 2.7 or older gets Microsoft's version, so install it only where a game needs it.

lastVerified.result: winetricks xact completes (exit 0) on a fresh environment with the app's bundled cabextract. windows/syswow64/xaudio2_7.dll is then Microsoft's (527,192 bytes, dated 2010-06-02) and user.reg prefers xaudio2_7, xactengine3_7 and x3daudio1_7 native,builtin. The 64-bit side keeps Wine's. Whether it mends a given game's sound is per game; not yet checked with Binary Domain.
